blind.description: A stylized wooden interrogation or electric chair. It is constructed from warm brown wooden planks forming the seat, backrest, legs, and flat armrests, reinforced by dark iron brackets, metal bands, and rounded rivets. Reddish-brown leather restraint straps with metallic buckles are mounted on the armrests and lower front legs, accompanied by a curved metal restraint band across the upper chest/neck area. At the front between the legs is a small dark metal footrest step, and the entire chair is mounted securely to a rectangular dark metal baseplate with corner bolts.
blind.from_above: Viewed from straight above, it displays the top edges of three backrest planks, an arched metal restraint hoop projecting forward over the slatted wooden seat, wide armrests flanked by reddish-brown buckled straps, and the rectangular metallic footrest and baseplate extending forward.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 3.5 feet tall (about 60% of the figure's height) and about 2 to 2.5 feet wide at the base.

notes: gemini note: bolted metal baseplate at base
